sources.title: Just-SM/Evaluation-and-Enhancement-of-RAG-in-Agentic-AI
sources.snippet: Overview This repository provides a reproducible RAG retrieval evaluation pipeline for single-cell biology notebooks. It was developed alongside the Kai agentic AI system to measure retrieval quality improvements from a storage migration (ChromaDB → LanceDB) and from different retrieval strategies (dense, hybrid, cross-encoder reranked).
